Edgar Saltus, Mr. Incoul’s Misadventure.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-saltus/mr-incouls-misadventure

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Saltus, the author, died 1921 (Wikidata Q3719069, P570 = 1921-07-31).

First publication of the text used: 1887, in the United States; New York: Benjamin and Bell, 1887, in the bibliography of the Edgar Saltus article. SE colophon: 'Mr. Incoul’s Misadventure was published in 1887 by Edgar Saltus.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1887, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1982.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States, so the rule above settles the country of origin too.
